trends.description: Customer mentions of 'battery health' up 400% in March. Exact percentage now mandatory expectation, not nice-to-have.
trends.impact: Critical - must display exact battery percentages and guarantee minimums prominently
trends.opportunity: Lead with battery health data, offer battery replacement services, create battery health guides
trends.evolution: Now includes requests for battery cycle counts and charging history

trends.description: iPhone 16 rumors accelerating current-gen price drops despite September release still 6 months away
trends.impact: High - creates urgency messaging opportunity while managing price decline expectations
trends.opportunity: Frame current pricing as 'perfect timing' before next wave of upgrades
trends.latest: Leak of iPhone 16 specs causing iPhone 14/15 holders to delay purchases

trends.description: Massive customer confusion about Lightning vs USB-C, which cases fit which models, wireless charging compatibility
trends.impact: High - creating purchase hesitation and returns from wrong accessories
trends.opportunity: Create definitive compatibility guides, offer guaranteed-compatible bundles, build trust through expertise
trends.source: Reddit threads showing daily questions about cable/case compatibility

trends.description: Confusion intensifying as more devices transition to USB-C while older phones remain Lightning
trends.impact: High - perfect opportunity for clear compatibility guides and curated bundles
trends.opportunity: Position as compatibility experts with clear guides and guaranteed bundles
trends.evolution: Now includes anxiety about fast charging compatibility and cable quality

trends.description: March showing highest refurb supply levels as customers upgrade during spring cleaning season
trends.impact: High - best selection and pricing power in months
trends.opportunity: Aggressive inventory acquisition while prices at lowest point
trends.latest: Supply up 23% week-over-week, quality grades improving

trends.description: Multiple competitors launching 'like-new' premium tiers at 85-90% of retail prices
trends.impact: Medium - creates opportunity to own true value position vs premium positioning
trends.opportunity: Emphasize real savings and value rather than chasing premium margins
trends.insight: Premium tiers make standard refurb look like better value - use this positioning

trends.description: Growing customer concern about Face ID/Touch ID reliability on refurbished devices
trends.impact: Medium - requires specific quality assurance messaging and testing guarantees
trends.opportunity: Guarantee biometric function testing, offer replacement if biometrics fail
trends.addition: Now includes concerns about Face ID with masks and Touch ID sensitivity
